limitations: One ordered, partly overlapping pair; both use Quality Code. Calendar time includes recorded interruptions and report correction; controller execution is wall time, not CPU time. Adaptive chose one same-model helper at medium effort, so cheaper-model implementation and hierarchical swarms were not tested. Conditional Standard API equivalents use request-level price tiers; they are not invoices or subscription measurements. Outer setup, orchestration, comparative grading and publication are excluded and are not free.
